कैटरीना कैफ और विक्की कौशल की जोड़ी का एक और प्यारा रूप सामने आया है! 💖

हाल ही में CNBC-TV18 को दिए एक इंटरव्यू में कैटरीना कैफ ने अपने ब्रांड Kay Beauty और अपनी पर्सनल लाइफ के बारे में खुलकर बात की। 📱

कैटरीना ने खुलासा किया कि काम के चक्कर में वह संडे को भी बिजी रहती हैं, लेकिन पति विक्की कौशल उन्हें फोन नीचे रखने और ब्रेक लेने की याद दिलाते हैं। उन्होंने विक्की को बेहद सपोर्टिव बताते हुए कहा कि वह उनके हिस्टीरिया की शांति हैं। 🥰

दिसंबर 2021 में शादी करने वाले इस कपल के घर 7 नवंबर 2025 को बेटे विहान का जन्म हुआ। Vogue India से बातचीत में कैटरीना ने बताया कि 14, 16 या 18 घंटे काम करने के बाद भी विक्की अपने बेटे के साथ 100% मौजूद रहने वाले बेहतरीन पिता हैं। 👶

वर्कफ्रंट की बात करें तो कैटरीना को आखिरी बार 2024 की थ्रिलर फिल्म Merry Christmas में विजय सेतुपति के साथ देखा गया था।

क्या आपको भी विक्की कौशल और कैटरीना कैफ की यह क्यूट बॉन्डिंग पसंद है? कमेंट्स में अपनी राय जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: ‘Vicky Kaushal is the peace to my hysteria,’ says Katrina Kaif: ‘He’s incredibly supportive’
ctx.text:
Katrina Kaif has revealed that her husband , actor Vicky Kaushal, has to often remind her to take a break from work as she remains deeply involved in building her beauty brand, Kay Beauty. The actor said her passion for the business often means working beyond regular hours, including weekends. Speaking to CNBC-TV18 alongside Nykaa co-founder Adwaita Nayar, Katrina opened up about the journey of building Kay Beauty, the demands of entrepreneurship and the challenge of balancing multiple roles, particularly after becoming a mother.
Talking about the amount of time and effort that goes into running the brand, Katrina said, “You cannot count the hours. There is one person who keeps counting them, and that’s my husband, who keeps telling me to put my phone down. But when you are passionate about something, you don’t count the hours or look at the clock. There are days when we find ourselves discussing work even on Sundays.”
Katrina said that a strong passion for one’s work is essential for anyone aspiring to become an entrepreneur. She said it is this passion that gives people the confidence to take risks, overcome challenges and stay committed to their business goals.
ALSO READ: Anirudh Ravichander, Kavya Maran forego religious rituals, choose self-respect wedding: here’s its meaning
Katrina also spoke about navigating the different roles in her life, from being an actor and entrepreneur to a wife and mother. Rather than putting pressure on herself to strike the perfect balance, she said she has learnt to give herself time and space to adjust.
“I think you have to be graceful with yourself. Give yourself time and breathing space, and allow yourself to find your feet in each of these roles as they change. Whether you are an actor, a businesswoman, a wife or a mother, you have to allow yourself the time to figure out how to balance everything,” she said.
She added that it was equally important not to be too hard on oneself during stressful moments.
“If you don’t get it right every time, or there are moments when you feel overwhelmed and are running around trying to manage everything, you have to be kind to yourself. My husband is incredibly supportive. He is the peace to my hysteria,” she said.
Katrina and Vicky Kaushal, who got married in December 2021, welcomed their first child, a baby boy, on November 7, 2025.
Katrina previously opened up about motherhood and how it has changed her perspective on life and work. In a recent interview with Vogue India, the actor spoke about her postpartum journey and refusing to give in to the pressure of returning to her pre-pregnancy body.
“Bounce back? From where?” she said, adding, “I have taken a step ahead to something that was a deep desire in my heart, so why would I want to go back?” Katrina revealed that seeing her son Vihaan for the first time was an indescribable feeling.
The actor also praised Vicky for being a hands-on father despite his demanding work schedule. “As a father, he’s been amazing. He has this incredible superpower to be 100 per cent present in the moment with Vihaan and me, even when he is tired and has been working 14, 16 or 18 hours a day,” she told the publication.
On the acting front, Katrina Kaif was last seen in Sriram Raghavan’s 2024 thriller Merry Christmas , in which she shared screen space with Vijay Sethupathi.
